description: This file defines the Error utility class for Drupal, providing methods for decoding exceptions, logging errors, rendering exception messages, and handling backtraces.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Utility class for error handling, exception decoding, and backtrace formatting in Drupal.

methods.name: decodeException
methods.description: Decodes an exception to extract message, caller info, backtrace, and other details.

methods.name: logException
methods.description: Logs a formatted exception message to a PSR logger.

methods.name: renderExceptionSafe
methods.description: Renders an exception message safely for display, including a formatted backtrace.

methods.name: getLastCaller
methods.description: Retrieves the last caller from a backtrace, skipping internal functions and ignored functions.

methods.name: formatBacktrace
methods.description: Formats a PHP backtrace into a plain-text string for display.

methods.name: currentErrorHandler
methods.description: Returns the current PHP error handler as a callable (deprecated).
